summary: The partnership aims to empower Qatari and non-Qatari youth through quality academic programs

The University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Thani Bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services. Image courtesy: UDST

The partnership aims to empower Qatari and non-Qatari youth through quality academic programs

Press Release

Doha, Qatar: The University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Thani Bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services, establishing a framework for collaboration to expand access to quality higher education for sponsored students from underserved backgrounds in Qatar. The partnership aims to empower Qatari and non-Qatari youth through quality academic programs, capacity development, and financial support, enabling them to make meaningful contributions in Qatar and globally.

The agreement is signed by Dr. Salem Al-Naemi, President of the University of Doha for Science and Technology, and Dr. Ayedh bin Dabsan Al-Qahtani, Chief Executive Officer of Thani Bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services.

The Memorandum of Understanding establishes a framework for cooperation in supporting sponsored students throughout their academic journey, including developing mechanisms for financial assistance with tuition fees, providing academic support, and creating an enabling environment that promotes student success and educational achievement.

Commenting on the agreement, Dr. Salem Al-Naemi, President of UDST, said:

"This Memorandum of Understanding reflects our commitment to expanding access to quality education and creating meaningful opportunities for students to achieve their academic aspirations. Through our collaboration with the Thani Bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services, we aim to empower sponsored students by providing the support they need to pursue higher education while contributing to the development of highly qualified graduates who support Qatar's national priorities and future aspirations."

Dr. Ayedh bin Dabsan Al-Qahtani, Chief Executive Officer of Thani Bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services, said:

"This partnership reflects our shared commitment to investing in people through education and empowering young individuals to realize their full potential. By supporting sponsored students throughout their academic journey, we seek to create lasting opportunities that contribute to building capable generations equipped to serve their communities and support Qatar's continued development."

The MoU further strengthens cooperation between the two institutions and reflects their mutual commitment to supporting education, human development, and social responsibility by expanding educational opportunities and empowering students to build a brighter future through knowledge and lifelong learning.

About University of Doha for Science and Technology:

University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Emiri Decision No13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic, applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST has over 80 bachelor's and master's degree programs, diplomas, and certificates. The university houses 5 colleges: the College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, in addition to specialized training centers for individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student-centered learning and state-of-the-art facilities. Its world-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.
